Branch

  • CURIE: gmeow:Branch
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Branch
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software
  • Box roles: TBox role (What is this?)

A mutable pointer to a line of development in a repository — a named reference that advances as new commits are added. An InformationObject, not an Event or Entity.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:InformationObject

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:Branch as a specialized kind of gmeow:InformationObject. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:InformationObject
